explication: NodeGoat is an intentionally vulnerable Node.js web application for learning OWASP Top 10 risks. A user enters through the Express web server, signs in or creates an account, then uses authenticated dashboard features such as profile, contributions, benefits, allocations, memos, and research; the tutorial is a separate learning route. Route handlers own feature actions and use data-access objects to persist or retrieve MongoDB records. The graph preserves those documented feature branches and the tutorial. Some DAO-to-route links are supported by the source index; unsampled view wiring and storage details are not expanded beyond explicit evidence.
